websites.description: Full-stack music library with React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and Supabase. Browse songs, artists, and albums with a global audio player. Deployed on AWS Amplify.
websites.challenge: Built a scalable music streaming architecture handling real-time audio playback state across components and efficient querying of large song datasets with PostgreSQL and Supabase.

websites.description: University timetable generator with a backtracking CSP algorithm. Manages lecturers, rooms, and faculties, then auto-generates conflict-free schedules. React 19, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Express, TypeORM, Supabase.
websites.challenge: Implemented a constraint satisfaction algorithm to automatically generate university schedules, resolving conflicts between lecturer availability, room capacity, and faculty requirements in polynomial time.

websites.description: React + TypeScript demo built with React Hook Form, Yup, styled-components, TanStack Query, and Axios. Submit a validated registration form and fetch live API data with caching.

Classic Battleship vs AI with Hunt/Target algorithm. React 19, TypeScript, Zustand, Framer Motion. Drag-and-drop ship placement, sound effects, hit/miss animations, game stats, and dark/light themes. Fully responsive.
Real-time MERN chat with Socket.io, typing indicators, emoji reactions, unread badges, and online presence. React 19 + Zustand frontend, Express 5 backend with JWT auth and Cloudinary uploads.
websites.challenge: Engineered real-time bidirectional communication with Socket.io, managing connection states, typing indicators, and message delivery across multiple concurrent users while maintaining data consistency.

websites.description: MERN real estate app with property search across 10 countries, dark mode, favorites, compare, price history charts, mortgage calculator, and Google Maps integration. JWT + Google auth, Cloudinary uploads, responsive UI.
websites.challenge: Designed a complex property filtering system with multi-criteria search, geolocation queries, and interactive map integration while handling large datasets efficiently across 10 countries.

websites.description: MERN e-commerce store with product search, cart, reviews, and server-verified PayPal checkout. React 19 + RTK Query front end, Express 5 API with JWT auth, Zod validation, and Cloudinary uploads. Serverless on Vercel.
Travel atlas of Armenia: 461 monasteries, fortresses and mountains from Wikidata. Search by region, find what's nearby, and plan a day on the map. MERN, serverless.
Food delivery app with React 19, Context API, Framer Motion, and Firebase Auth. Features 32+ meals, category filters, a slide-out cart, and 3-step checkout — no Redux or custom backend.

Fashion e-commerce with React 19, Redux Toolkit, and Framer Motion. Size/color variants, faceted filters, wishlist, quick-view modals, checkout flow, auth, order history, and dark mode. 26 products, fully responsive.
Day planner that turns plain text like "90m next tuesday" into a task, then warns when the day is overbooked against its set capacity. Built with React, Redux Toolkit.

Frontend interview quiz with 250+ questions across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and JS Tricky topics. Features timed questions, difficulty levels, high score tracking, and code block rendering. Built with React 19.

Music search app built with React 19 and Vite. Browse Apple's top 25 chart, search with debounce, paginate results, and preview 30-second clips. Custom hooks, skeleton loaders, and SCSS design tokens.

Cocktail encyclopedia with React 19, Redux Toolkit, and Vite. Browse 160+ recipes, filter by category or A-Z, save favorites, view recently viewed, and discover with Surprise Me. Lazy loading and skeleton states.
Joke app with text-to-speech, voice selector, 6 categories, saved jokes collection, and dark/light mode. PWA-installable, works offline. Built with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks.
Static travel site showcasing tours, customer stories, and contact info. Built with HTML, CSS, and JS for a responsive design with smooth, engaging animations.
